events.title: Evocation Steam Next Fest Demo Update
events.summary: The Evocation Demo officially joins Steam Next Fest today! To mark the occasion, we’ve temporarily closed the Playtest and moved into the Demo phase. All upcoming updates and adjustments will build on the Demo version.Since opening the Playtest, we’ve received so much feedback and so many suggestions from players. events.title: Evocation is participating in Steam Next Fest | Play the Demo and Wishlist Us!
events.summary: Hello everyone!Hi everyone! Our Card Game, Evocation, is officially participating in Steam Next Fest! We invite you to try out the demo and add the game to your wishlist!👿 About EvocationEvocation is a card game with unique gameplay, high interactivity, and deep mechanics. It includes a roguelike PvE mode and an online PvP mode without in-app purchases. Draw and maintain your magical circle, freely trade and craft equipment, and purge the heretics along the pilgrimage path.🔥 Free Demo Available

events.summary: PVP mode is now available! For now, it only supports English. We’ll add other languages once the version is stable.What does PVP mode include?175 cards – all free to use for building your own decks. events.title: May 27, 2026 Update Notice
events.summary: Fixed a serious bug that caused the tutorial to freeze. I'm sorry — I broke this while working on the PvP feature a while ago, but I never noticed it until now. The PvP mode is still in small-scale testing and has many stability issues. However, those participating in the tests have been tirelessly exploring new deck builds and have already played hundreds of matches, which makes me very happy. events.title: April 25, 2026 Update Notice
events.summary: Long time no see. Although we ran into some difficulties during the past few months of development, the online multiplayer mode is finally taking shape (though it's currently only available in the playtest version).This demo update itself doesn’t contain a lot of new content. We've buffed Zotiel, and reworked the save file structure to be compatible with new content coming in future updates. events.title: Update Log
events.summary: Fixed some UI layer issues caused by yesterday's update. We sincerely apologize for the rushed release without sufficient testing. We hope for your understanding if this affected your gameplay experience.Additionally, some new optimizations have been implemented.

events.title: Update Log
